messages.author: dd02671969f4a883
messages.subject: Re: xgboost
parts:
That all sounds great !

kth-nearest neighbour would be a nice addition too.

Also, adding ranger and randomUnifromForest to the random forest section would be great.
ranger is super-fast, while RUF has fantastic partial variable importance measures and visualisations.
Also ranger provides the new extraTrees functionality - randomising split points as well as candidate splitting variables,
and RUF allows quantile regression.

best regards,

Dr. Eugene Dubossarsky
Principal Trainer
Presciient
http://presciient.com/
0414573322
